purpose: Replace the r360 helmet-like scalp and open rear seam with an owned semantic hairline, native visible scalp, and collision-safe rear closure.

iterations.change: Natural asymmetric scalp contour, skin-adjacent scalp shader, short transition roots, reduced rear divergence.
iterations.evidence: Long roots below the designed hairline became sparse bangs; transition roots inherited excessive long-hair motion.

iterations.change: Filtered long roots below the hairline, detached transition roots from secondary motion, densified scalp boundary, added 44 rear bridge guides.
iterations.evidence: Rear triangular opening became a narrow seam, but the frontal scalp patch remained exposed.

iterations.change: Matched scalp shell to the owned body skin range, narrowed the part root gap, strongly routed front lengths toward the temples.
iterations.evidence: Removed the painted-cap colour difference but exposed too much frontal scalp.

iterations.change: Added 81 frontal guides with generated followers.
iterations.evidence: Followers collapsed into two brush-like frontal clumps.

iterations.change: Replaced frontal follower clumps with 324 independent head-bound overlay fibres.
iterations.evidence: Flow became continuous, but individual roots remained sparse and the redundant scalp shell seam was visible.

iterations.change: Disabled the redundant scalp shell and increased distributed frontal overlay to 968 independently varied fibres.
iterations.evidence: No shell seam, closed rear crown, stable exposure, and zero measured penetration. Hairline density and fibre grouping remain visibly procedural.

r366.nextRequiredChange: Replace uniformly distributed frontal fibres with authored low-frequency clumps and controlled density breakup while preserving the r366 native-scalp and rear-bridge architecture.
